issues.description: The problem statement and tasks ask students to implement getters for every attribute (implying public accessors and referring to tests like getLectureNameTest and getNumberOfInscribedStudentsTest), and the template contains TODOs for adding getters. However, the provided solution declares two of the getters (getLectureName and getNumberOfInscribedStudents) as private while their corresponding setters are public. This visibility mismatch is inconsistent with the exercise expectation of public getters and could confuse students or cause tests that expect public getters to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public to match the task description and tests. Specifically, change the visibility of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to public so they are consistent with the other accessors and the exercise requirements.
